subject: Make-Good Merit + Equity Regrant for Sarah Wu — Calibration Error
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: retroactive make-good (merit + partial equity) for Sarah Wu

Team —

Summary: During the November calibration pass an incorrect performance tag ("Meets") was applied to Sarah Wu on the Eng IC ladder after an early reorg that split her responsibilities across two pods. The calibration notes (attached) show her work should have been rated "Exceeds". The mistake materially impacted her midyear merit and excluded her from the equity refresh.

Ask: approval to (1) issue a retroactive prorated merit bonus of $7,500 (one-time cash) and (2) grant a make-good equity award of 0.025% (2,500 RSU-equivalent units, subject to normal grant docs) with a 1-year pro-rata vesting schedule to align to the original refresh cohort. I have attached a compact packet: performance evidence + proposed comp calc.

Why now: Sarah has already signed acceptance for a counteroffer from a competitor if we do not make her whole. Losing her would be high risk given her ownership on the vector-ops infra project.

Budget: Markus, if you confirm headcount/budget can absorb the cash and equity, we can route to payroll/legal/comp to finalize.

Attachments: sarah_performance_packet.pdf, proposed_comp_calc.xlsx, calibration_notes_ENG-Nov2026.pdf

Next steps I propose:
- Markus confirms budget authority (today)
- Laura/People confirm policy path and any precedent needed
- Rishi/Comp confirm equity mechanics and deal id mapping
- Neha/Finance confirm GL + chargeback (Q4 discretionary)

Thanks —
Jasmine

Jasmine Liu
Staff Software Engineer, Infra
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: retroactive make-good (merit + partial equity) for Sarah Wu

Thanks for the context, Jasmine — I reviewed the attachments. A few quick clarifying questions before I take this to People Director sign-off: 

1) Can you paste the calibration excerpt that shows the correction (who proposed the change, timestamp, and rationale)?
2) Does Sarah have any prior documented performance improvement plans or ongoing HR notes? (A negative history would change approvability.)
3) For the equity component: do you want this issued as a one-time special grant (non-refresh) or a backdated refresh-equivalent grant? Comp will weigh in on tax/vesting implications.

If we can get the calibration excerpt and confirm no adverse HR history, I can route to Director + Legal. If this is time-sensitive (you mentioned a competing offer), call me and I'll expedite.

-Laura

Laura Bennett
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Request: retroactive make-good (merit + partial equity) for Sarah Wu

Jasmine — appreciate flagging this. I reviewed the packet and confirm that:
- Sarah's work on vector-ops is mission-critical and she is the primary owner for the upcoming Q1 performance optimization rollout.
- There was a cross-pod tagging error during the reorg batch; ENG calibration notes attached corroborate Jasmine's summary.

Budget note: I can absorb a $7.5k one-time cash payment from my discretionary Q4 comp pool and allocate the requested 2,500 RSU-equivalent from the engineering equity tranche earmarked for makegoods/retention. Please proceed with People+Comp routing.

Quick actions I authorize:
* Laura — please treat this as an expedited make-good; director OK from me on record.
* Neha — I will approve chargeback to ENG Q4 pool

Markus
VP Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 10:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: retroactive make-good (merit + partial equity) for Sarah Wu

Thanks — two comp mechanics comments: 
1) Equity: We recommend issuing a special one-time grant (make-good) sized at 2,500 units with a 1-year pro-rata cliff to avoid backdating tax complexity. Label the grant as "MG-2026-SWu" and link to deal id EXC-2026-0023 in the comp system.
2) Cash: $7,500 can be processed as a one-time discretionary payout, taxed in the current payroll run. Confirm whether the manager wants it as a bonus code or a retroactive merit (different GL/visibility).

Also: provide the calibration excerpt (Laura requested) and a short manager rationale paragraph I can paste into the comp system for audit. Once I have those two items I can create the grant record and hand to Legal for DocuSign.

-Rishi
Senior Manager, Compensation Programs

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>

Finance notes — Neha here. Budget mapping confirmed: charge $7,500 to ENG discretionary Q4 (GL: 6600-ENG-COMP) and classify as a non-recurring retention payment. Equity will be funded from the reserved ENG make-good tranche; no headcount impact.

Operational asks: 
- Please submit a DocuSign amendment for the equity grant and cc payroll for cash processing.
- Once comp creates the grant record (MG-2026-SWu), send the DocuSign link and the payroll code you want ($7,500 as BONUS vs RETRO_MERIT). I will process same-day when I receive the DocuSign completion.

I'll mark this approved for chargeback on my side pending the DocuSign and comp record.

-Neha

Subject: Final: Approved — Make-Good Merit + Equity Amendment for Sarah Wu

Team / Sarah —

1) Cash make-good: $7,500 processed as BONUS (payroll code: BONUS_Q4_2026) charged to GL 6600-ENG-COMP. Payroll to include in December payroll cycle.

- Neha: please run the payroll code on receipt of DocuSign and comp id.

Sarah: I will loop you in on the DocuSign shortly. We appreciate your patience and want to be clear we value your work.

Forwarded for record: previous thread history and attachments (see earlier messages).
